title: Rolling Deployments Behind a Load Balancer
objective: Drain, update, test, and restore nodes without downtime.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: serial limits each batch and max_fail_percentage defines when to abort. Before changing a node, delegate a drain operation to the load balancer.
Deploy the release, restart if needed, wait for readiness, run an integration check, then return the node to service. Always provide rescue behavior for a failed node.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Drain, update, test, and restore nodes without downtime.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
rolling_deploy:
  batch_size: 1
  drain: delegated
  readiness_check: required
  integration_test: required
  restore_to_pool: after_success
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
